name: Formative Feedback Grounding & Actionability Comparison
research_question: Does candidate-specific structured feedback differ measurably from generic feedback in transcript grounding, misconception diagnosis, and actionable remediation?
hypothesis: Candidate-specific structured feedback achieves significantly higher verbatim transcript grounding, higher coverage of rubric gaps, and zero hallucinated claims compared to static generic feedback templates.

feedback_conditions.name: Generic Static Template Baseline
feedback_conditions.description: Standard boilerplate feedback selected solely by score bracket without candidate transcript or rubric concept grounding.

feedback_conditions.name: Evaluator-Structured Non-LLM Feedback
feedback_conditions.description: Deterministic structured feedback directly constructed from Stage 1 evaluator outputs without LLM generative formatting.
